```{r load}
source("utils/parameters.R")
tab <- function(name) {
  f <- file.path("results", "tables", paste0(name, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(f)) utils::read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
fig <- function(name) {
  f <- file.path("results", "figures", paste0(name, ".png"))
  if (file.exists(f)) normalizePath(f)
}
kable3 <- function(x, ...) {
  num <- vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))
  x[num] <- lapply(x[num], function(v) signif(v, 3))
  knitr::kable(x, row.names = FALSE, ...)
}
lst <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) < 2) return(x)
  paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
}
P <- PARAMS
t1 <- tab("Table1_traits"); t2 <- tab("Table2_spaces"); s1 <- tab("TableS1_missing_values")
t3 <- tab("Table3_procrustes"); t4 <- tab("Table4_metric_congruence")
t5 <- tab("Table5_nonnative_summary"); ie <- tab("TableS2_imputation_error")
n_sp <- if (!is.null(s1)) s1$n_species_analysed[1] else NA
dims <- unique(t1$dimension)
types <- c(Q = "continuous", O = "ordinal", N = "nominal", B = "multichoice",
           F = "fuzzy-coded", C = "circular", D = "binary")
type_tab <- table(t1$type)
type_txt <- lst(sprintf("%d %s", as.integer(type_tab),
                        ifelse(is.na(types[names(type_tab)]), names(type_tab), types[names(type_tab)])))
weighting_txt <- switch(P$weighting,
  variable = "each trait contributing equally to the distance, whatever its dimension (as in Toussaint et al. 2026)",
  dimension = "each functional dimension contributing equally to the distance",
  dimension_scaled = "each functional dimension contributing equally to the distance, after rescaling the distance of each dimension so that trait types are balanced",
  P$weighting)
tr <- t1$transform %in% setdiff(unique(t1$transform), c("none", NA))
txt_transform <- if (any(tr)) {
  by_tr <- split(t1$trait[tr], t1$transform[tr])
  sprintf("Continuous traits were transformed before analysis (%s).",
          paste(sprintf("%s: %s", names(by_tr), vapply(by_tr, lst, "")), collapse = "; "))
} else ""
one_dim <- vapply(P$spaces, length, 1L) == 1
txt_spaces <- paste0(
  if (any(one_dim)) sprintf("a functional space was built for each of the %d functional dimension%s",
                            sum(one_dim), if (sum(one_dim) > 1) "s" else "") else "",
  if (any(one_dim) && any(!one_dim)) " and " else "",
  if (any(!one_dim)) sprintf("%s for %s (%s)", if (any(one_dim)) "one" else "a functional space was built",
    if (sum(!one_dim) > 1) sprintf("each of %d combinations of dimensions", sum(!one_dim)) else "a combination of dimensions",
    paste(sprintf("%s: %s", names(P$spaces)[!one_dim],
                  vapply(P$spaces[!one_dim], paste, "", collapse = " + ")), collapse = "; ")) else "")
txt_missing <- switch(P$missing,
  keep = paste("Missing values were kept: the generalised Gower distance between two species",
               "was computed from the traits known for both (Pavoine et al. 2009)."),
  drop = "Species with at least one missing trait value were removed.",
  impute = sprintf(paste("Missing trait values were imputed with random forests (missForest;",
                         "Stekhoven & Bühlmann 2012; %d trees per forest), using the other traits%s%s",
                         "as predictors. Out-of-bag imputation errors are given in Table S2."),
                   P$ntree,
                   if (length(P$cov_cols)) sprintf(", %d additional predictor column(s) (%s)",
                                                   length(P$cov_cols), lst(P$cov_cols)) else "",
                   if (!is.null(P$phylo_file)) sprintf(" and the first %d phylogenetic eigenvectors",
                                                      P$n_phylo_axes) else ""))
txt_correction <- if (P$correction == "none") "without correction for negative eigenvalues" else
  sprintf("with the %s correction for negative eigenvalues", tools::toTitleCase(P$correction))
txt_axes <- if (is.null(P$max_axes)) "all axes with a positive eigenvalue were kept" else
  sprintf("the first %d axes were kept", P$max_axes)
txt_quality <- if (!is.null(fig("FigS2_quality"))) paste("The quality of each space was assessed with",
  "the mean absolute deviation between initial distances and distances in the space",
  "(mAD; Maire et al. 2015; Fig. S2).") else ""
txt_cmp <- if (!is.null(t3)) sprintf(paste("**Comparison of spaces.** Spaces were compared pairwise",
  "with Procrustes analyses on the species they share (%s, %d permutations; Peres-Neto & Jackson",
  "2001), using %s.%s"),
  if (P$method == "ade4") "ade4::procuste.rtest" else "symmetric vegan::protest", P$nrepet,
  if (is.null(P$n_axes)) "all PCoA axes" else sprintf("the first %d PCoA axes", P$n_axes),
  if (isTRUE(P$mantel)) " Mantel tests (Pearson) between distance matrices were added." else "") else ""
txt_metrics <- if (!is.null(tab("TableS5_species_metrics"))) sprintf(paste(
  "**Species-level metrics.** In each space, functional uniqueness (FUn) was measured as the sum",
  "of the Euclidean distances of a species to its %d nearest neighbours, and functional",
  "specialisation (FSp) as its distance to the centroid of the space (Mouillot et al. 2013);",
  "both were rescaled to [0, 1] within each space.%s The congruence of species rankings between",
  "spaces was measured with Spearman correlations and with the overlap (Jaccard index) of the",
  "%g%% most distinct species."), P$k,
  if (!is.null(P$iucn_col)) paste(" FUSE was computed as log(1 + P x FSp + P x FUn), with P the",
    "extinction probability of the IUCN category of the species (EDGE2; Gumbs et al. 2023),",
    "following Pimiento et al. (2020).") else "", 100 * P$top) else ""
nn <- P$nonnative
txt_nn <- if (!is.null(t5)) sprintf(paste("**Non-native species.** %s In each space, the functional",
  "novelty (FNov) of a non-native species was measured as its distance to the nearest native",
  "species, and its position was compared to the convex hull of native species (first %d axes).",
  "For native species, the relative change in FUn once non-native species are added was computed,",
  "and for the whole fauna the change in functional richness, dispersion, originality and mean",
  "pairwise distance%s."),
  if (identical(nn$source, "simulate")) sprintf(paste("Introductions were simulated for exploration:",
    "%g%% of the species were given a non-native status, with a %s bias in the %s space."),
    100 * nn$prop, nn$bias, nn$sim_space) else
    sprintf("Species status was read from the column '%s' ('%s' = native).", P$status_col, nn$native),
  nn$hull_axes,
  if (!identical(nn$null, "none")) sprintf(", compared to %d null replicates (%s)", nn$nrep, nn$null) else "") else ""
```

# Methods

**Data.** The analysis covers `r format(n_sp, big.mark = ",")` species described by
`r nrow(t1)` traits (`r type_txt`) assigned to `r length(dims)` functional
dimension`r if (length(dims) > 1) "s" else ""` (`r lst(dims)`; Table 1).
`r txt_transform`

**Missing values.** `r txt_missing`
The percentage of missing values per trait before and after this step is given in Table S1.

**Functional spaces.** Following Toussaint et al. (2026), `r txt_spaces`.
Distances between species were computed with the generalised Gower distance
(Pavoine et al. 2009; `ade4::dist.ktab`, Dray & Dufour 2007), with one table per
dimension and trait type, `r weighting_txt`. Each distance matrix was ordinated
with a Principal Coordinates Analysis (PCoA; `ape::pcoa`, Paradis & Schliep 2019)
`r txt_correction`,
and `r txt_axes`.
`r txt_quality`

`r txt_cmp`

`r txt_metrics`

`r txt_nn`

All analyses were run in R with the package DisentFunSpaces ({{DFS_VERSION}};
Toussaint et al. 2026); versions of R and packages are listed in `session_info.txt`.

# Results

```{r spaces-text, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(t2)) {
  best <- t2[which.max(t2$cum4_pct), ]
  cat(sprintf(paste0("The first four PCoA axes explained between %.1f%% and %.1f%% of the inertia ",
                     "of the spaces (Table 2), the most in the %s space."),
              min(t2$cum4_pct), max(t2$cum4_pct), best$space), "\n\n")
}
if (!is.null(t3)) {
  cat(sprintf(paste0("Procrustes correlations between spaces ranged from %.2f (%s vs %s) to %.2f ",
                     "(%s vs %s) (Table 3, Fig. 2)."),
              min(t3$r), t3$space1[which.min(t3$r)], t3$space2[which.min(t3$r)],
              max(t3$r), t3$space1[which.max(t3$r)], t3$space2[which.max(t3$r)]), "\n\n")
}
if (!is.null(t4)) {
  f <- t4[t4$metric == "FUn", ]
  if (nrow(f)) cat(sprintf(paste0("Spearman correlations between the rankings of species by functional ",
                                  "uniqueness in two spaces ranged from %.2f to %.2f (Table 4)."),
                           min(f$spearman), max(f$spearman)), "\n\n")
}
```

# References

Dray S., Dufour A.-B. (2007) The ade4 package: implementing the duality diagram for ecologists. *Journal of Statistical Software* 22(4): 1--20.

Gumbs R. et al. (2023) The EDGE2 protocol: advancing the prioritisation of Evolutionarily Distinct and Globally Endangered species for practical conservation action. *PLoS Biology* 21: e3001991.

Maire E., Grenouillet G., Brosse S., Villéger S. (2015) How many dimensions are needed to accurately assess functional diversity? A pragmatic approach for assessing the quality of functional spaces. *Global Ecology and Biogeography* 24: 728--740.

Mouillot D. et al. (2013) Rare species support vulnerable functions in high-diversity ecosystems. *PLoS Biology* 11: e1001569.

Paradis E., Schliep K. (2019) ape 5.0: an environment for modern phylogenetics and evolutionary analyses in R. *Bioinformatics* 35: 526--528.

Pavoine S., Vallet J., Dufour A.-B., Gachet S., Daniel H. (2009) On the challenge of treating various types of variables: application for improving the measurement of functional diversity. *Oikos* 118: 391--402.

Peres-Neto P.R., Jackson D.A. (2001) How well do multivariate data sets match? The advantages of a Procrustean superimposition approach over the Mantel test. *Oecologia* 129: 169--178.

Pimiento C. et al. (2020) Functional diversity of marine megafauna in the Anthropocene. *Science Advances* 6: eaay7650.

Stekhoven D.J., Bühlmann P. (2012) MissForest -- non-parametric missing value imputation for mixed-type data. *Bioinformatics* 28: 112--118.

Toussaint A., Tedesco P., Grenouillet G., Kasari-Toussaint L., Brosse S. (2026) Disentangling functional spaces: a multidimensional framework for ecology and conservation. *Ecography* e08578. doi:10.1002/ecog.08578
